app.title: Sunflower Diagnosis
app.tagline: Identify sunflower crop diseases from observed symptoms.

landing.hero_subtitle: Helping Cambodian sunflower growers quickly identify crop diseases and get expert management recommendations.
landing.how_it_works_subtitle: Three simple steps to protect your sunflower yield
landing.step1_desc: Observe symptoms on sunflower leaves, stems, roots, or flower heads in your field.
landing.step2_desc: Select simple Yes, No, or Not Sure responses for each symptom you observe.
landing.step3_desc: Receive instant ranked diagnoses with confidence scores and actionable treatment guidance.
landing.featured_subtitle: Learn about prevalent pathogens affecting sunflower crops
landing.trust_desc: Full Khmer & English support, optimized for mobile phones on slow field connections, backed by agricultural agronomy standards.

about.title: About Sunflower Expert System
about.subtitle: Bilingual AI Diagnostic Platform for Cambodian Agriculture
about.description: Developed to assist Cambodian sunflower growers with rapid field disease identification. Combining agronomist knowledge bases with probabilistic multi-attribute decision algorithms.
about.feature1_desc: Evaluates positive, negative, and pathognomonic symptoms rather than naive match ratios.
about.feature2_desc: Engineered for mid-range mobile devices with ultra-low payload sizes and offline-first design principles.
about.feature3_desc: Fully localized agronomic terminology crafted specifically for local farming communities.
about.disclaimer_desc: This system provides diagnostic decision support based on recorded disease rules. Always verify with field agronomists before critical interventions.
